rules.series: Awazzzz Mindset, in English — "Machiavelli's Rules" (power, strategy, self-reliance), "Rumi's Voice" (inner peace, love, purpose) and "Mind vs Heart" (both thinkers on one question).
rules.truth: Quote only from public-domain translations you actually read: Machiavelli, The Prince (W. K. Marriott 1908, Project Gutenberg) and Discourses (Ninian Hill Thomson 1883); Rumi, Masnavi (E. H. Whinfield 1887/1898; R. A. Nicholson vols. published before 1929) and Selected Poems from the Divani Shamsi Tabriz (Nicholson 1898). Quote the translation's own English wording (modernise spelling only) and name the book, chapter and translator on screen. Never use popular internet 'Rumi quotes' unless found in those texts (many are Coleman Barks paraphrases, which are copyrighted, or fakes). Paraphrase clearly marked as 'saar' (gist) when not a direct line.
rules.tone: Motivational and practical: every video ends with one action the viewer can do today. Machiavelli = strategy for career, business and life, never advice to harm, cheat or manipulate people; frame dark ideas as 'samjho taaki koi tumhare saath na kare'. Rumi = universal, spiritual, non-sectarian; respectful; no religious rulings.
rules.visual: Dark cinematic 2.5D: Machiavelli = candlelit Florentine study, chessboard, lion and fox, crown, ink and parchment, red/black/gold; Rumi = moonlit desert, whirling silhouette with flowing robe, reed flute, lanterns, deep blue/teal/gold; Clash = split screen red vs blue. Thinkers only as stylised silhouettes, no portraits. Full-bleed picture, minimal text.
rules.language: English narration and English subtitles (Hassan, Nov 17, 2026). Titles and examples in plain global English; examples may come from work, business, school, sport, family.
